actions.shape.group: Name of the Group selection action: the first item in the field's right-click menu while two or more marchers are selected, and its name in the command palette and shortcut settings. It makes the selected marchers one shape where they stand: nobody moves, and from then on they move, turn and scale together.
actions.shape.groupKeywords: Search words for the Group action in the command palette, separated by spaces. Not shown; translate as words people might type to find it.
actions.shape.ungroup: Name of the Ungroup action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Ungroup turns a placed shape (a box of marchers) back into plain marchers: they stay where they are and stop moving as one shape from that page on.
actions.shape.ungroupKeywords: Search words for the Ungroup action in the command palette, separated by spaces. Not shown; translate as words people might type to find it.
audio.contextMenu.beat.errorCreatingMeas: Error toast when "Mark as Measure" in a beat's right-click menu on the timeline fails to start a new measure at that beat.
fieldDisplay.caption.direction: Very short caption under the Field direction button in the field display bar (one word if possible): which way the field faces on screen.
fieldDisplay.caption.sections: Very short caption under the Visible sections button in the field display bar (one word if possible). Sections are groups of the band, such as trumpets or color guard.
fieldDisplay.comingSoon: Shown in the tooltip and screen-reader label of field display bar buttons that are not available yet.
fieldDisplay.direction: Tooltip name of a field display bar button that will turn which way the field faces on screen (for example, the audience at the bottom or the top). The button is not available yet.
fieldDisplay.label: Screen-reader label for the field display bar, a column of small buttons at the top right of the field that change what the field shows (marcher labels, shape outlines and so on).
fieldDisplay.sections: Tooltip name of a field display bar button that will choose which sections of the band are shown on the field. The button is not available yet.
launchpage.learn.troubleshooting.refresh: Troubleshooting tip on the Learn page of the start screen: reloading the app often fixes problems. <keys></keys> is replaced by the reload keyboard shortcut, shown as a key (Command-R on a Mac, Ctrl+R elsewhere).
library.import.choices.grip.picking: Label of the grip button while the import waits for the person to click a point on the 3D model (the grip is where a performer holds the prop). Pressing the button again or the key stops picking. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
library.import.stage.pickGrip: Hint over the 3D preview while importing a prop model, after the person chose to set the grip (where a performer holds the prop): they click the point on the model. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
marchers.csv.info: Help text at the top of the form that imports marchers from a CSV (spreadsheet) file. Says which columns can be left empty, that rows with errors aren't imported, and that the import can be undone. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Undo keyboard shortcut, shown as a key (Command-Z on a Mac, Ctrl+Z elsewhere).
marchers.deleteWarning: Confirmation message before deleting marchers from the marcher list. {marchers} is a comma-separated list of the marchers' drill numbers (such as T1, T2). <keys></keys> is replaced by the Undo keyboard shortcut, shown as a key (Command-Z on a Mac, Ctrl+Z elsewhere).
music.undoWithCtrlZ: Note under a tempo change on its card in the music editor, telling the person the change can be reversed. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Undo keyboard shortcut, shown as a key (Command-Z on a Mac, Ctrl+Z elsewhere).
settings.shortcuts.conflict: Warning in the keyboard shortcuts settings when the shortcut just pressed already belongs to other actions. <keys></keys> is replaced by that shortcut, shown as a key; {actions} is a comma-separated list of the action names that use it. {binding} is the same shortcut as plain text, kept for older translations.
settings.shortcuts.recording: Status shown in a row of the keyboard shortcuts settings while the app waits for the person to press the new shortcut. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
shapes.edit.drawHint: Hint shown over the field after picking a shape kind on the Shapes tab, before drawing it. {shape} is the shape's name in lowercase (for example box or circle). <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
shapes.edit.ungroup: Tooltip of the Ungroup button in the floating bar shown over a selected shape on the field. Clicking it turns the shape back into plain marchers who keep their spots.
shapes.kinds.group.label: Name of a kind of shape, shown on a placed shape's label and in its floating editor bar: a group of marchers kept as they stood, with no regular form such as a box or circle.
shapes.kinds.group.params.interval: Tooltip of the one number in a group's floating editor bar: the smallest distance between two neighboring marchers in the group, in steps. Changing it scales the whole group.
shapes.placed.groupError: Error toast when grouping the selected marchers into a shape fails.
shapes.placed.ungroupError: Error toast when ungrouping a placed shape (turning it back into plain marchers) fails.
shapes.placed.ungroupIsolated: Error toast when Ungroup is used while one move on the timeline is isolated, on a shape that was made on an earlier page. The user has to leave isolation first.
shapes.tool.tab.ringHint: Hint beside the shape buttons on the Shapes toolbar tab. <keys></keys> is replaced by the keyboard shortcut (shown as a key) that opens the shape ring, a round menu of shapes; the person holds that key with the pointer over the field. {key} is the same shortcut as plain text, kept for older translations.
shortcut.gesture.click: The word for a mouse or trackpad gesture inside a keyboard shortcut, written after the keys, as in “Shift + click” (hold Shift while you click). Lowercase unless your language capitalizes it here. Keep it short: it sits inside a small key-shaped label.
shortcut.gesture.drag: The word for a mouse or trackpad gesture inside a keyboard shortcut, written after the keys, as in “Shift + drag” (hold Shift while you drag). Lowercase unless your language capitalizes it here. Keep it short: it sits inside a small key-shaped label.
shortcut.gesture.scroll: The word for a mouse or trackpad gesture inside a keyboard shortcut, written after the keys, as in “Shift + scroll” (hold Shift while you scroll). Lowercase unless your language capitalizes it here. Keep it short: it sits inside a small key-shaped label.
timeline.fit.hint: Second line of the tooltip on the timeline's Fit the show button (which zooms the timeline to show the whole show). Says that pressing it again returns to the previous zoom, and how else to zoom: pinch on a trackpad, or scroll while holding a key. <keys></keys> is replaced by that key and the word for scrolling, shown as a key (Command + scroll on a Mac, Ctrl + scroll elsewhere).
timeline.focusNotice.body: Notice shown at the top of the window while the timeline has keyboard focus and the rest of the editor ignores input. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
timeline.focusNotice.exit: Button in the timeline focus notice that gives the keyboard back to the main editor (the field).
timeline.rangeMenu.setAsShown: Menu item in a page's right-click menu on the timeline. Stores the selected marchers' current on-field positions as set (fixed) positions on that page, so they stop following the move around them.
timeline.rangeMenu.setAsShownNone: Why "Set as shown" is unavailable, shown next to the disabled menu item. {page} is a page name such as "Page 3". "Set" means a marcher has a stored position on that page; "partway through a move" means the marcher is in the middle of a move there.
toolbar.collisions.collisionsToolbar: Screen-reader label for the Collisions toolbar section, which lists marchers who are too close together on the current page.
view3d.autoOpenPrompt.description: Second line of the 3D View's "open on launch" question card. Settings › General is the app settings section where the answer can be changed later.
view3d.autoOpenPrompt.no: Button answering no to the 3D View's "open on launch" question: the 3D View won't open by itself (it stays open for now).
view3d.autoOpenPrompt.title: Question in a card at the bottom right of the 3D View window, shown each time the window opens until answered: should the 3D View open by itself whenever a show is opened?
view3d.autoOpenPrompt.yes: Button answering yes to the 3D View's "open on launch" question: the 3D View will open by itself with every show.
actions.shape.curve: Name of a shape action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Text: "Shape: Curve".
actions.shape.hideMarchers: Name of a shape action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Text: "Shape: Hide the marchers (hold to peek, tap to keep hidden)".
actions.shape.hideMarchersKeywords: Search keywords (space separated, not shown) for a shape action in the command palette. Text: "hide show marchers spots walks alone peek eye".
actions.shape.line: Name of a shape action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Text: "Shape: Line".
actions.shape.removeLastPoint: Name of a shape action in the command palette and shortcut settings. Text: "Shape: Remove the last point while drawing".
field.gestureChip.keepDirection: Small chip near the pointer naming what a held modifier key does during a drag on the field. Text: "keep direction".
shapes.edit.drawPointsHint: Hint in the shape editor while the Line or Curve tool is armed and nothing is drawn yet. {shape} is "line" or "curve" in lower case. Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key shown as a keycap.
shapes.edit.hideMarchers.hide: Tooltip of the eye button in the shape editor bar that hides the edited shape's own marchers (also hold or tap H). Text: "Hide the marchers".
shapes.edit.hideMarchers.show: Tooltip of the eye button in the shape editor bar that hides the edited shape's own marchers (also hold or tap H). Text: "Show the marchers".
shapes.edit.order.keep: In the shape editor, the Who goes where menu: how marchers are assigned to the spots of a shape they move into. Text: "Keep order".
shapes.edit.order.label: In the shape editor, the Who goes where menu: how marchers are assigned to the spots of a shape they move into. Text: "Who goes where".
shapes.edit.order.nearest: In the shape editor, the Who goes where menu: how marchers are assigned to the spots of a shape they move into. Text: "Least travel".
shapes.edit.order.reverse: In the shape editor, the Who goes where menu: how marchers are assigned to the spots of a shape they move into. Text: "Reverse order".
shapes.edit.recalculate.alreadyInOrder: Tooltip of the Recalculate button in the shape editor, which works out again who goes where. Text: "Who goes where is already in order along the line".
shapes.edit.recalculate.titleInOrder: Tooltip of the Recalculate button in the shape editor, which works out again who goes where. Text: "Recalculate who goes where, in order along the line".
shapes.edit.removePointHint: Hint shown in the shape editor while drawing a Line point by point. Text: "Right-click or <keys></keys> removes the last point · Double-click to finish · <esc></esc> to cancel". <keys></keys> is replaced by the remove-point key shortcut and <esc></esc> by the Escape key, each shown as a keycap.
shapes.edit.removePointHintClick: Hint shown in the shape editor while drawing a Line point by point. Text: "Right-click removes the last point · Double-click to finish · <esc></esc> to cancel". <esc></esc> is replaced by the Escape key shown as a keycap.
shapes.groups.add: Inline interval chips in the Line shape's floating editor bar (a run of marchers at its own spacing). Text: "Add a group".
shapes.groups.addGroup: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Add group".
shapes.groups.all: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "All {count}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.at: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "at".
shapes.groups.count: Inline interval chips in the Line shape's floating editor bar (a run of marchers at its own spacing). Text: "Group {n} marchers". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. {n} is the group's position in the list (1st, 2nd…), not a count.
shapes.groups.countDropped: Inline interval chips in the Line shape's floating editor bar (a run of marchers at its own spacing). Text: "Group {n} marchers: none left for it". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. {n} is the group's position in the list (1st, 2nd…), not a count.
shapes.groups.countRest: Inline interval chips in the Line shape's floating editor bar (a run of marchers at its own spacing). Text: "Group {n}: the rest of the marchers. Type a count to fix it". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. {n} is the group's position in the list (1st, 2nd…), not a count.
shapes.groups.first: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "First {count}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.grown: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Grew by {count} to take the marchers no group has". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.interval: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Group {n} spacing, in steps". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. {n} is the group's position in the list (1st, 2nd…), not a count.
shapes.groups.last: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Last {count}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.list: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "All groups as a list: count * steps, + between groups".
shapes.groups.menuLabel: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Multiple intervals: {groups}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.menuName: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Interval groups".
shapes.groups.menuTip: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Groups of marchers at their own intervals".
shapes.groups.multiple: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Multiple intervals".
shapes.groups.next: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Next {count}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.groups.noMarchers: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "No marchers left".
shapes.groups.remove: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "Remove group {n}". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them. {n} is the group's position in the list (1st, 2nd…), not a count.
shapes.groups.restShort: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "rest".
shapes.groups.theRest: In the Line shape's floating editor, the Multiple intervals menu that lists the line's interval groups (runs of marchers at their own spacing). Text: "the rest,".
shapes.kinds.line.corners.label: In the Line shape editor: whether every corner of the line holds a marcher. Text: "Corners".
shapes.kinds.line.corners.off: In the Line shape editor: whether every corner of the line holds a marcher. Text: "Intervals run around corners".
shapes.kinds.line.corners.on: In the Line shape editor: whether every corner of the line holds a marcher. Text: "Marcher on every corner".
shapes.kinds.line.ends.closed: In the Line shape editor (a line of marchers drawn on the field). Text: "Closed".
shapes.kinds.line.ends.label: In the Line shape editor (a line of marchers drawn on the field). Text: "Open or closed".
shapes.kinds.line.ends.open: In the Line shape editor (a line of marchers drawn on the field). Text: "Open".
shapes.kinds.line.lock.locked: In the Line shape editor (a line of marchers drawn on the field). Text: "Interval locked: dragging an end keeps it. Click to unlock".
shapes.kinds.line.lock.unlocked: In the Line shape editor (a line of marchers drawn on the field). Text: "Lock the interval, so dragging an end keeps it".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.along: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Along the path".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.label: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Measured".

shapes.kinds.line.measured.noY: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "The line doesn't go front to back".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.offset: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Offset".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.offsetGroups: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Only with one interval for everyone".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.offsetPath: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Not with Interval on the path".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.offsetSegment: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Only on a one-segment line".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.squareX: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Part of the line runs straight front to back".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.squareY: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Part of the line runs straight side to side".
shapes.kinds.line.measured.straight: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "Straight across".

shapes.kinds.line.measured.y: In the Line shape editor's Measured menu: what a typed interval between marchers measures. Text: "↕ Front to back".

shapes.spacing.emptyGroup: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: "There's an empty group in the list. Type a group between each +: 2*3+4*2".
shapes.spacing.noMarchers: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: "A group needs at least 1 marcher".
shapes.spacing.notCount: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: ""{count}" isn't a number of marchers. Type a whole count before the interval: 2*3". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.spacing.notInterval: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: ""{part}" isn't an interval. Type steps (2), or a count and steps for each group (2*3+4*2)". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.spacing.tooManyMarchers: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: "A group can have at most {max} marchers". Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
shapes.spacing.twoRests: Error or note shown in the shape editor when the typed interval list for a shape can't be read. Text: "Only one group can go without a count (the rest). Type a count before the others: 2*3".
shapes.groups.countAt: One label drawn on the field for a whole interval group when its gaps are too small to label one by one, e.g. "4 at 2": {count} marchers at {interval} steps apart. Words in braces are filled in by the app; keep them.
visuals.cue.pickingPoint: Button label in the Visuals cue panel while the app waits for the person to click a point on the field, for a cue that needs a position. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Escape key, shown as a key.
web.welcome.backUpBody: Paragraph in the welcome dialog of the web version of OpenMarch, which keeps shows in the browser. Explains backing up. <keys></keys> is replaced by the Save keyboard shortcut, shown as a key (Command-S on a Mac, Ctrl+S elsewhere); {save} is the same shortcut as plain text, kept for older translations.
